info.title: Quality Dashboard
info.description: Consolidates SonarQube metrics and OWASP ZAP scan results into a one-page quality and security dashboard (HTML, PDF, Word) with traffic lights and trends.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: Quality Dashboard: consolidates SonarQube and OWASP ZAP results into a one-page report.

options.name: --file-name
options.description: Output file name without extension (default: quality-dashboard)

options.name: --zap-root
options.description:
Folder that relative zapReport paths resolve against
(default: the config file's folder)

options.name: --browser-path
options.description:
Edge/Chrome used for PDF output (default: auto-detect,
or QD_BROWSER_PATH)

options.name: --history-db
options.description:
SQLite file that stores ZAP results for trends
(default: config historyDb, else
%APPDATA%\QualityDashboard\history.db)

options.name: --no-history
options.description: Don't read or write the history database

options.name: --demo
options.description: Use built-in sample data (no SonarQube needed)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
The SonarQube token is read from the environment variable named in config
(sonar.tokenEnv, default SONAR_TOKEN).
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid arguments/config, all projects failed, or an output failed.
